title: Statehood
description: Texas achieved statehood 1845 (28th). The road to statehood ran through territorial government, population thresholds, and a congressional enabling act — the standard American path. Annexation 1845; Civil War. Statehood Day is still celebrated, and the admission order gives Texas its number among the states.

title: Capital: Austin
d: Austin is the capital of Texas.

description: Austin has been the seat of Texas government, home to the capitol building, the supreme court, and the legislature.
